_doc: Profiles. Public fields render on people.html and the press kit; people with public: false are not rendered. 'role' is the title, shown only when role_status is 'confirmed' or 'records-agree'; it is null when 'unconfirmed'. buildlib/content.py checks both against 'role_records' (rules in docs/leadership-reconciliation.md): 'confirmed' needs a record from a management confirmation dated after 2026-09-23 whose wording contains the title; 'records-agree' needs two records whose 'title' agrees, at least one dated 2025 or later other than the August 2026 teaser, and no record giving a different title (unless marked 'compatible': held alongside it). A record's 'title' is the title as that record gives it and must appear in its 'wording'. No chair or committee title unless confirmed. 'descriptor' is a field of expertise, remit or neutral description, never a job title, and is always shown: it needs two 'descriptor_records', at least one not the teaser. Each responsibility needs a record dated 2025 or later other than the teaser. 'bio_verification' is a level from facts.json covering the bio and affiliations; below document/primary it blocks production, as for facts. 'consent_to_publish' is the person's written consent to the profile; false blocks production. Every title that is not 'confirmed' blocks production. Records, 'review' and 'sources' are internal. A portrait renders only if 'portrait.file' exists under src/assets AND 'portrait.authorised' is true; otherwise nothing is rendered in its place. 'disclosures' renders only when non-empty and sourced. Interview modules render only when complete (see interviews.json).
